source: terrace green-contrast histogram peaks, multitest chip_2 (graphite on ~90 nm SiO2, oxide fit 81.9 nm), 2026-10-02, using only near-neutral terraces (R/G 0.8-1.2, B/G 0.5-0.85): ~12-15 nm graphite has the same green contrast as 1-4 layers but R/G >= 1.5 and B/G <= 0.35 (e.g. flakes 7, 63). Layer assignment 1-4 from the peak sequence (consistent with the user's identification of flakes 69, 89, 92, 97, 101, 105 as mono/bilayer)
nominal_note: used for chips entered as this nominal oxide whatever the analysis's fitted oxide (which depends on the colour model: 78-82 nm with the 2026-10 profile for wafers measured at ~93 nm); oxide_nm +- oxide_tol_nm applies only when no nominal oxide is known
